rationale: The agent canceled the entire order and stated a refund would be issued without first confirming any order-changing action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. The user initially asked about splitting payment and alternative cost-reduction steps; the agent neither attempted nor clarified those options nor handed off if unsupported. Authentication is not clearly established beyond using user-provided details, and the agent performed modification/cancellation actions without explicit confirmation. Therefore, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
